We offer a variety of specialty flights and charters throughout Southern Ontario. services.name: Wine Tours
services.desc: Canada has so many unique and one-of-a-kind experiences they are almost too numerous to count. Some of the top experiences have been recognized by our National Tourism Organization, the Canadian Tourism Commission, as a Signature Experience. Niagara Helicopters offers a tour that truly showcases two of Canada’s greatest treasures - Niagara Falls and Niagara Wineries from the greatest vantage point available - above it all. Beyond the city limits of Niagara Falls lie the vast picturesque orchards and vineyards of the Niagara Fruit Belt. services.name: Flight Path
services.desc: Located only minutes away from The Falls with plenty of free parking, Niagara Helicopters unique "No Fly, No Pay" policy applies and if for any reason you are unable to fly your ticket is refunded from the point of purchase. No questions asked. Fallsview area is home to many fine hotels and attractions such as the Imax Theatre, Fallsview Casino Resort, Skylon Tower, Fallsview Marriott and more! Commonly known as the Canadian Horseshoe Falls, they tower at over 188 feet high, and the rim of the Horseshoe Falls measures 2200 feet across - the same as Yosemite's famous Cathedral Spires. As you look at the American Falls you will notice the United States on one side and Canada on the other.

blurb: Guests experience a scenic helicopter flight over Niagara Falls, seeing natural and man-made wonders from above. Flights offer views extending to Toronto and Lake Erie on clear days. The company has over 50 years of service with experienced pilots and customized helicopters featuring individual headsets with taped commentary.
